errata.notes: Noticed that the "self" and "related" links in Figure 13 and Figure 14 examples have the same "href" value. From RFC 9083: A "related" link relation MUST NOT include an "href" URI that is the same as the "self" link relation "href" URI to reduce the risk of infinite client processing loops. (The new "href" values for the "related" links are per James Gould's earlier suggestion.)
